QuestInfo.name: Operation, Go!
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cartalion to hear about the mission.
QuestInfo.1: You need to report that Magnus appeared at the West Border. Go to #bPantheon#k and see #bCartalion#k.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, Kaiser endured the strike from Magnus, and Magnus left when Cartalion arrived at the West Border on reports from Velderoth. Magnus wasn't defeated, but the strategy was a huge success in destroying the invading force.
